api_base.description: Base URL for DynamoAI API. If not provided, the `DYNAMOAI_API_BASE` environment variable is checked, defaults to https://api.dynamo.ai

api_key.description: API key for DynamoAI Guardrails. If not provided, the `DYNAMOAI_API_KEY` environment variable is checked.

guardrail_name.description: Name of the guardrail for identification in logs and traces.

model_id.description: Model ID for tracking/logging purposes. If not provided, the `DYNAMOAI_MODEL_ID` environment variable is checked.

policy_ids.description: List of DynamoAI policy IDs to apply. If not provided, the `DYNAMOAI_POLICY_IDS` environment variable is checked (comma-separated).
